metadata.title: Municipal Corporation Zonal & Headquarters (HQ) Departments Dataset
metadata.query: Co-ordinate of all NMC zonal and hq department of Pune in json file
metadata.clarification_note: The query requests coordinates for "NMC zonal and hq department of Pune". In Maharashtra administrative nomenclature, municipal affairs in Pune are governed by the Pune Municipal Corporation (PMC), which operates 1 Central Headquarters, 5 Zonal Headquarters, and 15 Ward Offices, alongside the Pimpri Chinchwad Municipal Corporation (PCMC) in the twin-city metropolitan region (8 Zonal Offices). The acronym "NMC" officially denotes the Nagpur Municipal Corporation (comprising 1 Central HQ and 10 Zonal Offices). Both the complete Pune municipal administrative framework (PMC & PCMC) and the NMC Nagpur zonal framework are comprehensively indexed below.
